description: TenantKeep Posture check catalog. One file per domain. Copyright (c) 2026 Kainor LLC; the catalog text, logic and framework mappings are the protected part of the product (LICENSE.md). domains: every domain in report order with its label; the report, the findings export and the public catalog page read it, so a new domain is data only. attack: the MITRE ATT&CK release the checks' technique ids are checked against; build.ps1 -Task AttackData writes checks/attack.json from that release and refuses any other. changes: one entry per catalog version whose checks changed meaning, with the checks that can move for a tenant that did not change and why; the trend reads it so a result that moved with the catalog is not called a new failure or a fix.

changes.summary: A hundred and twenty-seven new checks, most from settings the run already collects, two from new reads on permissions already held, twelve on how Microsoft Sentinel workspaces are set up, twenty on Global Secure Access and fifteen in a new domain, Power Platform and Power BI, read with two optional permissions, one check that now asks for what its title always said, and the CISA SCuBA ids brought up to CISA's current baselines, which changes which checks the SCuBA baseline selects.

changes.summary: Four new checks from reads that each need a new read permission on the consent, and federation signing certificates on the expiry calendar.

checks.OP-006: The expiry calendar gains the token-signing certificate of each federated domain. Where one could not be read, a calendar with nothing near its date has no answer.
checks.OP-011: New: Message Center posts whose act-by date is inside the warning window.
checks.HY-034: New: open Defender for Identity health issues.
checks.DEV-025: New: whether an Intune multi-admin approval policy exists.
checks.DEV-026: New: Intune role assignments that give a writing role over every device and user.

changes.summary: Ten new checks from reads that need no new permission, and a longer expiry calendar.

checks.OP-006: The expiry calendar gains Apple Automated Device Enrollment tokens, trial subscriptions and subscriptions in their grace period, so it can list items it did not know about before.
checks.OP-009: New: Secure Score against its best day in the last 90.
checks.OP-010: New: subscriptions in their grace period, suspended or locked out.
checks.DEV-024: New: Intune certificate connectors that have stopped answering.
checks.ID-024: New: applications that hold Graph application permissions and have not signed in for 90 days.
checks.AZ-029: New: the share of evaluated resources that comply with Azure Policy.
checks.AZ-030: New: Azure Lighthouse delegations that give another tenant more than read access.
checks.EM-028: New: whether Exchange Online rejects Direct Send.
checks.CL-017: New: how long a deleted user's OneDrive is kept.
checks.CL-018: New: OneDrive sync limited to the organisation's own domain-joined computers (hybrid tenants).
checks.CL-019: New: idle browser sessions signed out of SharePoint and OneDrive.

changes.summary: A check has no answer where its data is missing or was read in part, instead of a pass or a fail. Administrators are counted as people: a role held through a group, or as eligible, counts. Affected counts above 500 are the true number.
